English: Morning, Sir!
Diana.
I need to refuel the motorbike, any ideas?
Have another look around, there's probably something you haven't spotted.
I need another hint about refuelling the bike.
You might be able to find a container for storing fuel nearby.
There's an empty fuel canister near the pneumatic station, I'd start there.
I've got the fuel canister, but it's empty. What now?
Well, you'll need to get fuel from somewhere.
I need another hint about refuelling the bike.
You should inspect the other vehicles, see if there's any fuel left over.
That rubber tubing looks useful, but it's stuck.
You might be able to remove it, with the right tool.
I need another hint about the rubber tubing.
You'll need something sharp to cut that tubing out.
That wiring kit looks sharp, have you asked the quartermaster about it?
The quartermaster won't let me have the wiring kit, what now?
That might be a dead end, she's not going to bend the rules. What else can you see?
I need another hint, what should I do?
If the quartermaster won't give you that item, maybe you can take it!
I need another hint, what should I do?
There's a cage on that desk, have you had a peek inside yet?
I've located Agent M, she's a miniature thief!
A thief might come in handy! What else can you find?
I need another hint, what should I do?
With the right equipment, I'm sure you can get Agent M to help you.
I need another hint, what should I do?
There's a pile of discarded pneumatic containers, why not take one?
What should I do with this pneumatic container?
You can put something in there and send it to the quartermaster's booth!
I need another hint about the pneumatic container.
You'll want to send something to that booth, but what?
I need another hint about the pneumatic container.
You can send Agent M through the pipes directly to that quartermaster's booth!
Do you know how the pneumatic station works?
Those levers should control where the package ends up, try different combinations and see where it goes.
I need another hint about the pneumatic station.
Have a closer look at the pipes, can you see a pattern?
I need another hint about the pneumatic station.
The levers and pipes have symbols on them, match those symbols and you're all set!
I've got the wiring kit, what should I do now?
I'd be careful with that, it looks pretty sharp, useful for slicing through stuff though.
I need another hint about the wiring kit.
You can use the wiring kit to snip off the rubber tubing in the car.
I've got the rubber tubing, what should I do now?
That rubber tubing should help you refuel!
With the right equipment, you could use that tube to help syphon fuel.
If you combine that rubber tubing with the fuel canister, I bet you could make an effective syphoning tool.
I've made the syphon kit, what's next?
That other vehicle might have some leftover fuel.
I need another hint about syphoning the fuel.
You should try to syphon the fuel from that vehicle.
I need another hint about syphoning fuel.
That vehicle might have some fuel left over, try syphoning it out of the fuel inlet.
I need to fix the faulty wiring on the motorbike.
You've got a wiring kit, don't you? Try using that.
The bike is fixed, what should I do now?
Nothing left to do but ride out of there in style!
Good luck on your mission, agent!
Well, I'm not officially an a-
Oh, he's gone.
I've got it from here, thanks.
Look, lady. We just want to know the truth. Can't you just tell us what happened?
I'd love to tell you, officer, but I'm afraid it's all classified.
Top secret. My lips are sealed.
*Groan*
Bailey, we've been at this for days... I'm not sure if I have it in me any more.
Diana, please. We're all just looking to wrap this up.
Was it money? Vengeance? A burning hatred for the elderly?
The tragic death of Lady Unterwald wasn't my doing, in fact it made my mission terribly complicated.
Mission? What mission?
We found you at the scene, Diana. But you weren't on the manifest.
There's no record of you ever boarding the train.
Probably just a clerical error. I'm sure it happens all the time.
It's highly suspicious, you have to admit.
This is the sort of detail that could be very compelling to a jury.
Fine, I can tell you aren't going to stop asking. But it won't do you any good, you know!
Start at the beginning.
Alright, so that explains how you got on the train. What happened next?
I believe you're well aware of what happened next, detective.
Indulge us.
*Sigh*
Well, it all got a bit complicated.
I stuck to my orders, and made contact with the informant. Or so I thought...
